tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia had record lobbying quarters, confirmed by The Verge. The firms spent record amounts on safety, cybersecurity, and policy ahead of midterms.
METR finds flaws in OpenAI's internal monitoring system, confirmed by The Lufkin Daily News. Their research shows 75-94 percent of agent traffic goes unmonitored.
OpenAI urges California to strengthen its artificial intelligence safety law with additional safeguards, reported by StateScoop. New monitoring and cybersecurity rules are part of the push.
The Agentic Artificial Intelligence Foundation announced four new projects in its first year, confirmed by PR Newswire. Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face, and Alibaba contributed to expand the foundation to 10 projects.
Google open-sources TorchTPU to run artificial intelligence apps on TPUs, reported by AI Insider. This joins Amazon in challenging Nvidia's dominance in artificial intelligence development.
Free every hour.
